# Polya

> Polya is a course-aware AI tutor for college students. It connects to the
> student's school Canvas, studies the actual course materials — readings,
> slides, pages, and lecture recordings — and tutors with hints, steps, and
> worked examples instead of handing over answers. Every answer cites the
> exact page, slide, or lecture moment it came from, and instructors set a
> per-course assistance policy (Open, Guided, Practice, or Review) that
> visibly governs how much Polya reveals.

Polya is built by Canvascope Inc. and named for George Pólya, whose book
How to Solve It taught teaching-by-questions. It is free to start: students
sign in with Google and connect their school's Canvas.

## Pages

- [Home](https://askpolya.com/): what Polya does, how it works, and answers to common questions
- [How Polya works](https://askpolya.com/how-it-works): the full student walkthrough — connecting a course, citations, and the help ladder
- [For instructors](https://askpolya.com/for-instructors): the per-course assistance policies and how they govern Polya
- [Sign in](https://askpolya.com/login): Google sign-in for students
- [Privacy](https://askpolya.com/privacy): how Polya handles accounts, Canvas connections, and course materials
- [Terms](https://askpolya.com/terms): the terms that govern use of Polya
- [Contact](https://askpolya.com/contact): how to reach the team
